articles.title: Sebi approves net settlement of cash market trades for mutual funds
articles.desc: India’s Securities and Exchange Board of India (SEBI) has greenlit the introduction of net settlement for mutual fund schemes, set to take effect on April 1, 2027. Eligible transactions will now be confined to sales or purchases of a specific security, while cross-scheme netting will remain prohibited.

Despite higher expenses, the EBITDA margins held strong above 20%. Looking forward, EPL is set to focus on sustained revenue growth and stable profit margins.

articles.title: Blinkit Ambulance to charge Rs 2,500 for non-emergency trips; emergency service will stay free: Deepinder Goyal

articles.desc: S Jaishankar met UK Prime Minister Andy Burnham in Antigua and Barbuda for CHOGM 2026 discussions. They focused on strengthening economic partnerships under the Comprehensive Economic and Trade Agreement. Jaishankar emphasized the importance of digital solutions and climate initiatives during a Commonwealth meeting. He highlighted local distribution networks and the role of the Indian business community in fostering connections.

articles.title: US sanctions India-based couple, companies over alleged support for Iran's Shadow oil fleet
articles.desc: The United States imposed sanctions on Suniel Kumar Sharma and Jaspreet Preeti Shahid for aiding Iran's shadow fleet. Their network allegedly provided fraudulent maritime registrations to help sanctioned vessels transport Iranian petroleum. Several companies linked to the couple also received sanctions under Executive Order 13902. Additionally, a Turkiye-based company was sanctioned for providing services to US-designated Iranian airlines.

articles.title: Qualcomm is betting big on data centers as smartphone sales sink

During its Q4 2026 earnings call, the company laid out its plans to make a splash in the AI data center business, through partnerships with companies like Amazon and Meta announced earlier […]

articles.title: Big factories dominate India's manufacturing output, Annual Survey of Industries shows
articles.desc: India's manufacturing sector is characterised by a significant concentration in large factories generating substantial output. Factories producing over ₹500 crore contribute to more than three-fifths of total value added. Smaller factories represent a large number but have minimal output and value contribution.

articles.title: New orders & robust demand lift India's October services growth to 4-month high
articles.desc: Growth in India's services sector increased to a four-month high in October due to strong domestic demand and business orders. The HSBC Services Business Activity Index rose to 55.8, reflecting improved business conditions. Conversely, manufacturing activity showed a slight decline, easing to a PMI of 54.7. While input prices continued to rise, the rate of increase was the slowest in over six years.

articles.title: US slaps sanctions on Indian, Turkish firms and people for aiding Iran
articles.desc: The sanctions are part of the Trump administration's "Operation Economic Outcast," which aims to cut off Iran's ability to sell oil to fund the war with the US and Israel. Treasury unveiled the new sanctions a day after Democrats made huge gains in midterm elections, winning control of both houses of Congress as voters expressed anger about the Iran war and its impact in fueling US inflation.

articles.title: Over half of street vendors may cut UPI acceptance if 0.4% MDR is introduced: ISB study
articles.desc: More than 67% of street vendors in India currently accept UPI payments for transactions. A proposed 0.4% merchant discount rate could lead to reduced acceptance among vendors. Concerns arise particularly for vendor-supplier transactions, as many vendors make payments above ₹2,000. A significant portion of vendors faced additional charges from suppliers and might pass costs onto customers.

articles.title: Government prepares draft sustainable aviation fuels policy; moots mandatory blending in ATF from 2027
articles.desc: The civil aviation ministry has circulated the draft National Policy on Sustainable Aviation Fuels which mandates use of only indigenously manufactured SAF to be blended with Aviation Turbine Fuel (ATF).

articles.title: Piyush Goyal sets March 2027 deadline for digitisation of DGFT services, aims to end physical visits
articles.desc: Commerce Minister Piyush Goyal has set March 31, 2027, as the deadline for complete digitisation of DGFT services, including licence, permit and SCOMET approvals. From April 1, businesses will no longer need physical visits to government offices for these services. The move also includes digitising historical records and simplifying procedures.
